title: Rental Car Damage Photo
scenario: After returning a rental car, a message claims damage and asks you to pay through a link.

answers.A: Pay the claim through the message before the dispute window closes.
answers.B: Check the damage claim in the rental company official account.
answers.C: Call the rental office using the number on your agreement.
answers.D: Send a photo of the car to the message sender for comparison.

explanation: Damage disputes need the rental company documented process. A payment link can bypass evidence, insurance, and the dispute route.
proTip: Use the agreement and official account as your source of truth.
